# S21 — Weekly planning session

Page to review the suggested week, swap/skip/lock meals, and confirm the plan (P0, P4).

## Why

This is the one weekly habit larder asks for, so it has to take a few minutes.

## Owner input

None. Owner decisions: 2026-11-04 (ADR 0013 Rules, S19): everyone can plan (any paired person can edit the plan); the planning session is Saturday evening; 6 dinners and 1 open night, the open night chosen when planning; a skipped meal rolls to the next open night. 2026-11-05: one tap on 'swap' replaces the meal with the next-ranked alternative (no picker). The S20 'suggested week looks sensible on imported recipes' check was deferred to this slice or the S30 trial: run it here once imported and tagged recipes exist, otherwise leave it for S30.

Owner decisions: 2026-11-05, spec-check answers: (1) the plan_confirmed hook is a plain in-repo registry in src/larder/planner/plan.py with subscribe(fn) and fire(event, week_start); subscribers run synchronously after the confirm transaction commits; no new dependency; (2) every save of a confirmed plan (swap, skip, lock, pick) fires plan_confirmed again with the week_start; there is no separate plan-edit event; (3) the confirmed state is a new nullable meal_plan.confirmed_at column (UTC ISO text, null means draft) added by migration 0006, and docs/specs/data-model.md is updated; (4) skipping a night keeps its planned_meal row with status 'skipped' (history ignores skips, so the recipe is freed), the open night has no row, all 7 nights are prefilled and the household taps one to make it the open night; rolling a skipped meal forward is the Today view's job (S22); (5) /plan opens by default on the first Sunday after today (today if Sunday), and a ?week= parameter selects another Sunday, including the current week, so a confirmed plan can be edited mid-week.

Owner decisions: 2026-11-05, spec-check answer: Confirm always works, whether zero, one or several nights are open; the open night is not required (this differs from the spec check's recommendation of exactly one).

Owner decisions: 2026-11-05, derived from the owner's 'one tap shows the next alternative' answer (not asked separately): repeated taps on swap for one night keep moving down the ranking: the swap form carries the recipe ids already shown for that night, they are filtered out, and each tap shows the next-ranked meal, with no schema change.

## Implement

1. Create the week's `meal_plan` from `suggest_week`.
2. Per night: swap, skip, lock, or pick any recipe.
3. Confirm saves the plan and fires a `plan_confirmed` hook (the list slice subscribes).
4. Mobile-first layout; one screen.
